# Is Market Open

> A fast, minimal web app that shows the live status of the US stock market
> (NYSE & NASDAQ) — open, closed, pre-market, or after-hours — with a real-time
> countdown to the next open or close. Daylight saving time and US market
> holidays are handled automatically. All times are based on the
> America/New_York exchange clock.

## Key facts

- Regular session: 9:30 AM – 4:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday–Friday.
- Pre-market: 4:00 AM – 9:30 AM ET.
- After-hours: 4:00 PM – 8:00 PM ET.
- Closed: weekends and US market holidays.
- Early close (half-days): regular session ends at 1:00 PM ET (e.g. the day
  after Thanksgiving and Christmas Eve); after-hours then runs to 5:00 PM ET.
- Daylight saving time is applied automatically via the IANA time zone
  database (America/New_York), so the display is correct year-round.

## 2026 market holidays (full closures)

New Year's Day (Jan 1), Martin Luther King Jr. Day (Jan 19),
Presidents' Day (Feb 16), Good Friday (Apr 3), Memorial Day (May 25),
Juneteenth (Jun 19), Independence Day observed (Jul 3), Labor Day (Sep 7),
Thanksgiving (Nov 26), Christmas (Dec 25).

## Pages

- [Home / live status](https://ismarketopen.app/): The main app with status,
  countdown, session timeline, and clocks for the user's time zone, Eastern,
  and Pacific.

## Notes

- This site is informational only and is not investment advice.
- Status updates every second client-side; there is no account or tracking.
